source_instruction: i am finding a eco friendly and leak proof plastic refillable bottle container with  protective case - style 1 color
query: Ugh, I totally forgot to water my pothos on the windowsill this morning before leaving the house, and I think my cat knocked over the stack of junk mail by the front door again too. I also need to remember to pick up oat milk on the way home because we ran out yesterday after making lattes. Oh, and I saw the cutest corgi wearing a tiny rain jacket on the walk over here, it made me smile so big. Anyway, I need refillable containers that are eco friendly and leak proof, under $20, and can you grab that one for me?
